rationale: The agent appears to have identified the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and looked up orders, but it did not follow key policy requirements or user preferences. For the skateboard, the user requested to see all shorter bamboo options with prices and to choose the most expensive; the agent only fetched one product and proceeded to execute an exchange without presenting options or obtaining explicit confirmation. For the garden hose, the user asked for an exchange to match a pending order’s type, but the agent initiated a return instead of an exchange and again showed no confirmation step. The policy requires confirming every order-changing action before taking it. Executing exchange_delivered_order_items and return_delivered_order_items without clear prior confirmation, not honoring the requested exchange for the hose, and not listing all options/prices for the skateboard means the request was not completed in line with the policy.
